description: Protects file write, edit, and MCP tool calls against sensitive system paths and embedded private keys.

rules.name: mcp_path_traversal_sensitive_dirs
rules.description: Blocks file writes, edits, or tool calls targeting /etc/shadow, /etc/sudoers, or private key files.
rules.message: Blocked tool access to protected system or credential file path.

rules.name: mcp_write_embedded_private_key
rules.description: Blocks writing PEM/OpenSSH private keys directly into workspace files.
rules.message: Blocked writing private cryptographic key material into file content.
